**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Quick pass: merges cleanly with main (trial merge, nothing to do), body complete (what changed, tested, not run, `Changelog: none`, closing keyword for the issue), pinning test named. Flagged ready.

Good:
- One test file, +3 lines (an import, a comment, one `posting::post_set(&world, &PostRef::Named("Fanuc Lathe".into()))`). Every assertion in the test is untouched: holder judged off its model frame, mirror stands clear, rub refuses to post. Not weakened.
- "Fanuc Lathe" is the shipped 2-axis turning post (`assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps`), so it serves turning. No src, refusal or safety check changed; the #1232 refusal stays and is what the fix now satisfies.

Local results (merged with main): `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test vendor_tool_body` 3/3 pass; `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.

Note (not blocking): drilling_axial, turning_blade, turning_holder and turning_insert_zone all select the same "Fanuc Lathe" post via the `SelectPost` command; this test uses `posting::post_set` directly, which is fine for test setup.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
